features.description: Asynchronous email notification subsystem. Listens to UserCreatedEvent, SpacePermissionGrantedEvent, and DocumentUpdatedEvent (AFTER_COMMIT) and sends email via JavaMailSender on a dedicated thread pool. Sender is configuration-driven (real SMTP vs logging no-op). Adds an admin test-email endpoint.

features.title: AI assistant: rewrite document text by style via routerai
features.description: Server-side proxy to an OpenAI-compatible provider (routerai.ru). Fixed action catalogue (formal, professional, simple, friendly, shorter, longer, grammar); the client sends only an action key. Assistant button in the document editor applies the result to the selection or the whole text. Optional: disabled or key-less installations hide the button and answer 503.

features.title: URL parameters support for all document list filters
features.description: Full URL parameter support for filters (spaceId, authorId, status, sortBy, sortDir, q, page). Preserves filters when navigating via space tree. Restores filter state from URL on page load.

features.title: Safe document save: CSRF-protected save with 401/403/400 handling and debounce autosave
features.description: Safe document save in edit page: explicit HTTP status handling (200/400/401/403), 3-second debounce autosave, status indicator (Saved/Unsaved/Saving/Error), CSRF-safe requests reusing XSRF-TOKEN cookie and credentials same-origin.
